description: This file declares the FullscreenColor class, which is a subclass of SampleBase, used for rendering fullscreen color graphics using Vulkan API. It includes method declarations for startup, cleanup, swapchain management, and frame recording, along with private members for Vulkan objects such as render pass, shader modules, pipeline, and swapchain image objects.

classes.name: FullscreenColor
classes.description: A class for managing fullscreen color rendering using Vulkan, derived from SampleBase, with methods for lifecycle management and Vulkan resource handling.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Static factory method to create an instance of FullscreenColor.

methods.name: StartUp
methods.description: Initializes resources needed to start rendering.

methods.description: Creates Vulkan objects dependent on the swapchain.

methods.name: DestroySwapchainDependents
methods.description: Destroys Vulkan objects dependent on the swapchain.

methods.name: RecordFrame
methods.description: Records commands for rendering a frame.
